task_description: In this scenario, the agents need to manage customer service by handling inquiries, escalating complex issues, and ensuring all tickets are tracked and resolved accurately. The agents must collaborate efficiently to prevent loss of context during handoffs and to keep ticket statuses synchronized, avoiding duplicate or conflicting responses.
expected_outcome: All customer inquiries are addressed appropriately, complex issues are escalated correctly, and all tickets are resolved with statuses updated consistently across the system.

agents.description: This agent is responsible for initial customer interactions, handling basic inquiries and creating tickets for issues that require further action.
This agent analyzes more complex customer issues and escalates them to the appropriate department if necessary.
This agent manages the lifecycle of tickets, ensuring they are updated and resolved appropriately while maintaining accurate status.
